headline: Madison Energy Infrastructure acquires NextEra's US DG platform; ~300 MW expansion opportunity for Raptor Solar onboarding and baseline inspections

signals.summary: Madison Energy Infrastructure acquired NextEra Energy Resources' US distributed generation development platform. This is a material portfolio expansion for a 1 GW C&I owner-operator, bringing new MW under management and requiring full onboarding to Raptor Solar as the system of record, plus baseline RS Inspections across the new assets.
signals.suggestedAction: Contact Matthew Messer (VP Asset Management) this week to confirm the acquisition scope (MW count, number of sites, geographic distribution, asset age/condition). Propose a two-phase onboarding: (1) backfill historical SCADA and maintenance data into Raptor Solar for anomaly baselining, then (2) full-fleet baseline inspection plan. Reference Project Slingshot success (3 MW recovery in 3 weeks) to establish credibility with the new assets.

headline: Madison Energy Infrastructure completes largest Fairfax County solar project at I-95 Landfill; baseline inspection and Raptor Solar onboarding opportunity

signals.summary: Madison Energy Infrastructure has completed construction on the largest solar project in Fairfax County history at the I-95 Landfill Complex. This represents either a new asset acquisition or a development reaching commercial operation—a material expansion event for a C&I owner-operator with 1 GW across 800 sites. Project size and site location (Fairfax County, Virginia) unknown from headline, but landfill-top solar projects typically range 5–50 MW depending on available space. If material to their portfolio, this is both a Raptor Solar onboarding trigger (baseline digital twin, SCADA integration, production analytics) and an RS Inspections commissioning QA play.
signals.suggestedAction: Reach out to Matthew Messer (VP Asset Management) to confirm: (1) project size in MW, (2) commissioning status and expected COD, (3) number of sites (often landfill projects are single-site but multi-block), and (4) whether initial baseline inspection and Raptor Solar onboarding is planned for Q2 or Q3. If not yet scanned, offer a rapid commissioning inspection package to validate DC/AC systems and catch any construction defects before handoff to operations.

headline: Madison Energy launches 1 GW Community Infrastructure Initiative for AI data center power; major fleet expansion opportunity for Raptor Solar + baseline inspections across new sites

signals.category: 1 GW Community Infrastructure Initiative for AI data centers
signals.summary: Madison Energy Infrastructure announced a 1 GW Community Infrastructure Initiative to power AI data centers. This represents a material expansion of their distributed C&I solar portfolio and likely involves dozens to hundreds of new sites across their footprint.
signals.suggestedAction: Contact Matthew Messer (VP Asset Management) or Esteban Schrick (Senior Manager of Analytics) this week to understand: (1) site count and geographic distribution of the 1 GW initiative; (2) timeline for construction/COD; (3) whether new sites will be onboarded to Raptor Solar as the shared system of record (consistent with their current architecture); (4) baseline inspection plan scope and schedule. Emphasize how Project Slingshot's success (3 MW recovered in 3 weeks) can be replicated across new assets, and propose a phased baseline inspection + production-recovery roadmap.
